title: Plan Safe Application Deployments
objective: Compare deployment strategies and encode controlled zero-downtime rollouts.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original companion material covering single-server, rolling, load-balanced, Capistrano-style, and blue-green deployment patterns.

paragraphs: A single-server deployment can provision dependencies, fetch a versioned release, migrate data, and restart the app, but usually has downtime. Separate provisioning from frequent application release steps when their lifecycles differ.
Rolling deployments use serial to update only part of a fleet. Tasks delegate to a load balancer to drain a node, deploy and test it, then return it to service before moving on.

Capistrano-style releases use versioned directories and an atomic current symlink. Blue-green keeps two complete environments and switches traffic after validation. Any strategy needs health checks and a rollback target.
explanation.rule: Never move traffic to a release until an automated health check passes.

examples.title: Rolling Batch
examples.code:
- name: Roll out application
  hosts: app_servers
  serial: 1
  max_fail_percentage: 0
  tasks:
    - name: Deploy release
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: Deploy and verify one node
examples.note: A batch size of one limits blast radius.

checks.question: What does serial control?
options: How many hosts a play processes at once

feedback.incorrect: serial batches target hosts during a play.

assignment.title: Limit a Rolling Deployment
assignment.brief: Target app_servers one at a time and stop if any host fails.
requirements: Set serial to 1 and max_fail_percentage to 0.
assignment.starterCode:
- name: Roll out application
  hosts: app_servers
assignment.solutionCode:
- name: Roll out application
  hosts: app_servers
  serial: 1
  max_fail_percentage: 0
  tasks:
    - name: Verify deployment plan
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: Deploy one host at a time
assignment.outputCheckLabel: Deployment plan uses valid course-style YAML

hints: Set the allowed failure percentage to zero.
